_comment: Document metadata for the DocuResearch evaluation corpus. Tags describe document characteristics for dataset curation tracking.

documents.name: Alpha Protocol Specification
documents.description: A technical specification for the Alpha Protocol, a secure data transmission protocol. Covers security requirements, authentication, performance, limitations, and revision history.

documents.name: Alpha Protocol Specification (Markdown)
documents.description: Same content as sample_spec.pdf but in Markdown format with clear heading hierarchy (H1 + H2 sections).

documents.name: Omega Framework Documentation
documents.description: Plain text documentation for the Omega Framework, a distributed systems library. Flat structure with paragraph-based organization.

documents.name: Omega Framework Release Notes
documents.description: Short release notes for the Omega Framework. Deliberately gives a first-release date (March 2018) that conflicts with sample_document.txt (2020); used by q-022.

documents.name: RFC 7519: JSON Web Token (JWT)
documents.description: The published IETF specification for JSON Web Tokens (30 pages, plain text, unmodified). Included as a realistic document: page headers/footers, a table of contents, definitions split across page breaks. RFCs may be copied in full under the IETF Trust Legal Provisions (BCP 78).
